messages:
nate: AE flagged a regional payments customer asking for a single purchasable bundle: Private (VPC) + regional data residency + guaranteed peak throughput credits + customer key option. wants a pilot in ~5w and a flat monthly invoice.

maria: is the ask an add-on to Private or a named product? sales wants a clean quote line they can hand mid-deal.

sam: prefer a named "RegionGuard" add-on for quoting simplicity. commercial wants a pilot discount and a clear conversion path to reserved commit.

frank: eng quick take: fastest launch = managed KMS + quota-based throughput credits on Dedicated pools. ETA ~3-4w for pilot (no HSM). Full customer-key/HSM path is 9-11w and needs key-wrapping & attestation work. per-tenant dedicated pools would also increase ops overhead.

leah: ops: must have per-tenant telemetry, billing events for credits, and a canary plan. I can build dashboards in ~8 business days if metric hooks are added now.

maria: launch acceptance minimums: runbook, canary thresholds, billing SKU + sample invoice, security signoff, and a conversion clause for pilot->commit.

sam: pricing ask: base Private reserved + RegionGuard flat add-on. pilot = 40% off for first 6w, conversion to min 3mo reserved commit. Ben (finance) needs unit economics to set the add-on price.

legal-bot: legal input: include data residency language, KMS options (customer vs Redwood-managed), and explicit pilot limitation clause if HSM not delivered during pilot. I'll draft addendum samples by Wed.

frank: tech note: include a supported-models matrix since some quantized runtimes have latency differences; add this to spec.

maria: owners: @frank = tech options doc (two paths) by Fri, @sam = commercial terms & pilot offer, @legal-bot = contract addendum, @leah = monitoring checklist.

sam: scheduling sync Mon 11am PT. if any timeline slippage call it out here.

maria: I'll pull everything into a one-pager decision memo for the sync. thanks.
